messages:
incident-bot: pager: HIGH p99 latency on /v1/chat/completions (us-west). Triggered 3x in 5m. Pager -> oncall_eng. Incident dashboard: <https://grafana.internal/redwood/inc/2765432101>
Drew H: Ack — I'm on traces and perf flamegraphs now. @Amira K can you take customer comms if impact is > 5m?
Amira K: Yep, free. Quick check: which models/routes are spiking? I see the interactive chat route is worst.
Kai L: Logs show p95 spike concentrated on route="interactive" and model=mistral-1 variants. Per-model breakdown attached to the grafana panel. Quick PromQL we used: ```histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le, model))```
Santiago R: Proposal for live mitigation: 1) temporary squelch / debouncing for low-traffic non-customer routes, 2) per-model partial weight shift to fallback smaller model for interactive routes, 3) raise alert noise gating so we don't page on short-lived spikes for non-prod routes.
Beth S: +1 on targeted changes. Concrete alert proposal: - page on p99(route, model) > 1200ms for 5m - create ticket-only alert for p95(route, model) > 800ms for 10m (so eng-monitoring can triage but avoid paging) Also create per-route+model heatmap panel in Grafana. I'll file ticket MON-1234.
Kai L: I'll open the PR to update the alerting rules and dashboard. Dashboard changes: per-route p95/p99 heatmap, model label breakdown, 1m/5m/15m tabs, and alert annotations. ETA ~45m for PR and preview.
Drew H: For immediate mitigation: enable kv-cache warmstart on the affected serving pools and shift 40% of interactive traffic to fallback-small-model. Ops: can you run a weighdown job for mistral-1 on interactive?
OpsBot: weighdown job submitted: model=mistral-1, route=interactive, new_traffic_weight=0.6. Cache warmstart triggered on us-west pools.
Amira K: Posted status: "Mitigating degraded latency on chat completions; routing and cache mitigations in progress. Will update with metrics." Sent to customers on impacted orgs.
Santiago R: Post-incident follow-up items: - spike-analysis doc (pre/post p95/p99) - list of changed alert thresholds and reasoning - dashboard links and runbook updates - monitoring sprint to apply per-route tuning globally. Assigning follow-ups to eng-monitoring.
Drew H: We'll keep pager open until p99 stabilizes for 10m across interactive in us-west. If stable, close and triage post-incident. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Beth S: Also recommend we don't globally increase p95 thresholds. We should prefer per-route/model rules and noise-gating. I'll include that in MON-1234.
Kai L: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerts/pull/512 — includes new rule set and dashboard JSON. Preview link attached.
Amira K: Noted. I'll prepare customer follow-up summary for the postmortem.
Drew H: Closing note — once mitigations show p99 < 1.1s for 10m, I'll clear the pager and schedule the monitoring retro.
